As Nvidia scandal unfolds, Episode 1936 looks at the evolution of China’s top spy agency— MSS over the years, since it was founded in June 1983.
ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains the operations of MSS, its wide reach and how it has grown under Xi Jinping. He also tells the stories of women spies, and how intel agencies have used them.
